stepNotes.1: PtyRoutes exposes six lazy Hono operations plus parsePtyReconnectCursor in pty.ts:15-239 and is mounted under /pty at server.ts:299-301; PTY_ID_PARAM supplies branded path validation.
stepNotes.2: POST accepts process-execution inputs, but server.listen enforces loopback at server.ts:345-366, browser upgrades pass origin checks at :183-195, cwd realpaths stay inside the project at pty/index.ts:379-397, and user env overrides are filtered at :131-141.
stepNotes.3: GET maps absent sessions to NotFoundError, but PUT serializes undefined from Pty.update and DELETE returns true when Pty.remove finds nothing; the combined 200 false-success/schema violation is a Medium missing-resource contract issue.
stepNotes.4: The connect lifecycle validates raw sockets, awaits Pty.connect, drains at most the queued messages, detects close-before-ready, and invokes subscriber cleanup at most once through the closed guard in pty.ts:172-235.
stepNotes.5: Pre-ready input is capped at 100 messages, replay storage at 2 MiB, replay chunks at 64 KiB, and stale subscribers are evicted; concurrent PTY process count itself has no lifetime cap beyond request-rate controls.
stepNotes.6: HTTP and runtime-upgrade concerns remain outside the PTY domain, which owns replay/process/subscriber state; Low contract drift remains because OpenAPI describes connect as 200 JSON boolean rather than a WebSocket with binary metadata frames.
stepNotes.7: The route has no empty catches or TODOs: setup exceptions are logged before queue clearing and close, invalid ws.raw shapes fail closed, and the shared validator maps Zod failures to client errors.
stepNotes.8: The audit ledger and absent findings directory contain no accepted records; focused tests cover cursor parsing, cwd/env/replay/lifecycle and socket reuse, but absent-ID PUT/DELETE and real upgrade race behavior are not tested.
stepNotes.9: Core typecheck passed; focused Vitest runs passed 58/58 PTY/validation tests and 19/19 server tests. One Medium plus Low follow-ups were recorded, with no Critical item and therefore no reverify.md requirement.
